verdict.rationale: Braintrust records token usage and metadata on every traced request, and the Logs page is a searchable, filterable table. That implies usage can be sliced by custom metadata fields, and business dimensions like customer segment can be defined for Topics clustering. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly describes cost (rather than tokens) or attribution to users, sessions, or features. Missing for 10: explicit cost computation, documented per-user/session/feature attribution via metadata, cost aggregation dashboards or group-by views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
